image_size.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `uint8`, `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`. 1-D, containing `[height, width, channels]`.
constraints: image_size must be one of uint8, int8, int16, int32, int64

bounding_boxes.description: A `Tensor` of type `float32`. 3-D with shape `[batch, N, 4]` describing the N bounding boxes associated with the image.

seed.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `0`. If `seed` is set to non-zero, the random number generator is seeded by the given `seed`. Otherwise, it is seeded by a random seed.

min_object_covered.description: A Tensor of type `float32`. Defaults to `0.1`. The cropped area of the image must contain at least this fraction of any bounding box supplied. The value of this parameter should be non-negative. In the case of 0, the cropped area does not need to overlap any of the bounding boxes supplied.
constraints: min_object_covered must be one of float32, 0.1

aspect_ratio_range.description: An optional list of `floats`. Defaults to `[0.75, 1.33]`. The cropped area of the image must have an aspect `ratio = width / height` within this range.

area_range.description: An optional list of `floats`. Defaults to `[0.05, 1]`. The cropped area of the image must contain a fraction of the supplied image within this range.

max_attempts.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `100`. Number of attempts at generating a cropped region of the image of the specified constraints. After `max_attempts` failures, return the entire image.

use_image_if_no_bounding_boxes.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. Controls behavior if no bounding boxes supplied. If true, assume an implicit bounding box covering the whole input. If false, raise an error.

output.description: A tuple of `Tensor` objects (begin, size, bboxes). A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `image_size`. 1-D, containing `[offset_height, offset_width, 0]`. Provide as input to `tf.slice`. size: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `image_size`. 1-D, containing `[target_height, target_width, -1]`. Provide as input to `tf.slice`. bboxes: A `Tensor` of type `float32`. 3-D with shape `[1, 1, 4]` containing the distorted bounding box. Provide as input to `tf.image.draw_bounding_boxes`.
